name: MD 600N
summary: A tall, slim single-turbine NOTAR helicopter with a six-blade rotor and no tail rotor; used for law enforcement and executive transport.

wings: Short mast and a wide rotor disc
engines: No tail rotor; air from the boom slot steers instead
fuselage: Tall slim cabin with a long glazed nose and a roomy cabin
tail: NOTAR: a smooth tapered boom with no tail rotor
Twin vertical stabilizers with a horizontal stabilizer at the boom end

tellTales: Six-blade rotor on a slim tall body with no tail rotor
Smooth NOTAR boom with twin fins
Single turbine on a long narrow fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The MD 500 has a five-blade rotor, an egg-shaped body and a conventional tail rotor; the 600N has six blades and a NOTAR tail.
The MD 900 has twin engines and a five-blade rotor; the 600N has one engine and six blades.
The H125 has a three-blade rotor and a conventional tail rotor; the 600N has six blades and no tail rotor.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
